blocks.text: Meet the immune-supportive and skin-nourishing Zinc supplement that your body can really, truly absorb.* Formulated with fermented Zinc that is shown in clinical research to be 1.6x better absorbed+, this easily digestible, one daily, easy to swallow Zinc supplement is gentle even on an empty stomach. We put quality first by crafting our Zinc complex with certified organic vegetables. Each tablet delivers 136% Daily Value of fermented Zinc PLUS 167% Daily Value of fermented Copper. Why Copper? Research shows that it’s important to maintain adequate Copper levels when taking products high in Zinc. Delivering a thoughtful Zinc-to-Copper balance is part of New Chapter’s holistic approach to supplements—looking at the big picture with nothing in isolation. Third party validations include certified gluten-free by NSF & Non-GMO Project Verified. *These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. +Compared to Zinc gluconate.
